summary: Front-month NG at $2.778 is essentially fair versus modeled fair value ($2.939, band $2.439-$3.439) and roughly in line at the next-month leg too, so there is no strong nominal mispricing to lean on right now. Net-net: a cautious longer-horizon long is supported by positioning, weather and seasonal-discount evidence, while the short-term picture lacks a clean directional edge and favors patience for a better-defined setup.
